tasks.title: Adding and subtracting vectors
tasks.statement: Add the methods __add__ and __sub__ to Vector: both return a new vector and leave the originals unchanged.
tasks.hint: return Vector(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y), and the same for subtraction.

tasks.title: Multiplying by a number from both sides
tasks.statement: Teach Vector to be multiplied by a number on the left and on the right: v * 3 and 3 * v give the same result. If the other operand is not a number (int or float), the method must return NotImplemented so that Python raises TypeError.
tasks.hint: __mul__: if not isinstance(k, (int, float)): return NotImplemented. And __rmul__ can simply return self * k.

tasks.title: Money under sum()
tasks.statement: Money stores an amount in cents. Write __add__ (adds only Money, otherwise NotImplemented) and __radd__ so that sum([Money(150), Money(250)]) works (sum starts from zero).
tasks.hint: __radd__(self, other): if other == 0: return self; otherwise NotImplemented.

tasks.title: The in-place += operator
tasks.statement: Bag already has __add__ (it returns a new bag). Add __iadd__ so that a += other changes the object a itself (appends the elements of other) and returns it.

tasks.title: Vector negation and length
tasks.statement: Complete Vector: -v returns a vector with opposite coordinates, and abs(v) returns the length of the vector (math.hypot).

tasks.title: An object as an index
tasks.statement: Make Step usable everywhere an integer by nature is needed: a list index, a slice, hex(), range(). One method is enough.

tasks.title: Matrix multiplication with @
tasks.statement: Complete __matmul__ for Matrix (it stores a list of rows in rows): element j of row i of the result is the sum of products of row i of the left matrix and column j of the right one. The result is a new Matrix.
tasks.hint: For each row r and each index j: sum(r[k] * other.rows[k][j] for k in range(len(r))).

tasks.title: An address with a slash
tasks.statement: Teach Url to be built with the / operator: Url("example.com") / "api" / "v1/" gives "example.com/api/v1" (extra slashes at the joints are removed). If the right operand is not a string, return NotImplemented.

tasks.title: Permission flags
tasks.statement: Perm stores a set of permissions in the three low bits (4 is read, 2 is write, 1 is execute). Write __or__ (union), __and__ (intersection), and __invert__ (complement to seven); each returns a new Perm.
tasks.hint: Perm(self.bits | other.bits), Perm(self.bits & other.bits), Perm(7 ^ self.bits).
